mapper.select: select coalesce(sum(case when s.physicalqty != 0 then s.totalcostamount else 0 end), 0) as stockAmount, count(distinct case when s.physicalqty > 0 then s.goodscode end) as skuCount from sdsshop.u_m_stock s where s.shop_code = #{shopCode} and s.onhandflag = 1
select count(1) from sdsshop.u_p_purchase where shop_code = #{shopCode} and status = 'submitted'
